exact_signature:
theorem singleBlockPrecision_regular {n : ℕ} (_hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (singleBlockPrecision κ O).IsHermitian ∧
      ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ,
        v ⬝ᵥ v ≤ v ⬝ᵥ (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ v) ∧
        v ⬝ᵥ (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ v) ≤ κ * (v ⬝ᵥ v)
definition: noncomputable def singleBlockPrecision {n : ℕ} (κ : ℝ) (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := ((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)

binder_audit.reason: Finite block dimension represented by Fin n; a carrier parameter, not an estimate.

The construction fixes 3 <= n <= d. Keeping 3 <= n is source-faithful even if an eventual single-block algebra proof can work in smaller dimensions. The ambient d and n <= d are not part of this bounded single-block carrier.
The hard family fixes kappa >= 4. Estimates such as kappa >= 1 and (kappa - 1)/2 >= 0 must be discharged from this premise inside the proof.

binder_audit.recursive_expansion: Real square matrix O with O * transpose O = I, equivalently transpose O * O = I; the group subtype carries exactly orthogonality.
binder_audit.reason: This is source O in O(n), including both determinant components. It is not SO(n), a random Haar matrix, or an arbitrary matrix with an additional spectral estimate.
All Euclidean coordinate vectors occur in the conclusion. There is no hidden premise about v or its norm.

scope: Single-block equation (26) only; full block regularity and minimizer remain open.
